name: bars-and-session
description: get_footprint bars (volume at price, POC, imbalance flags with tick 0.25); get_bars includeOrderFlow: MNQ bars carry NQ's flow, 5-minute bars with 2- and 3-bar windows reaching before the first bar, ofiQuote and the plain mean of minute bookImbalance on bars, a quiet complete 1-minute bar, hour bars; and the session cumulative delta from the 17:00 CT trading-day start.

cumulativeDelta.note: Unknown: not every minute since the session start (17:00 CT) is complete in live or recorded data.

coverage.note: Data starts when this server subscribed to the contract (on the first order-flow call for it); nothing before that exists unless the flow recorder wrote it.

orderFlow.note: complete=true means: the trade subscription was confirmed before the minute started and stayed connected through its end; the minute settled (a trade after its end + 2 s, or 10-20 s passed); hub messages kept arriving with no silence over 10 s; the quote feed's volume and last price agree with the prints (a quiet minute needs flat quote volume); and every print had a usable timestamp and a known side. Use a bar only when all its minutes are complete.
